meta.name: muapi-product-video-ad-maker
meta.description: Create a high-end cinematic product video advertisement starting from a simple product photo.

copy.tagline: 把产品照片变成电影级广告视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果手头只有产品图，却需要一条高端视频广告
copy.tagline_en: Turn product photos into cinematic ad videos
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have only product photos but need a high-end video ad

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据你上传的产品照片，先生成一张高质量的产品展示图，再把它变成一段电影感的视频广告。
howto.when: 当你上传产品照片，并说出“制作产品视频广告”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我用这张水杯照片做一个产品视频广告。
say.note: Claude 会先渲染产品图，再生成视频。

say.text: 给这张手表照片配上鲜花和晨光的场景，做成广告视频。
say.note: 你可以自定义场景描述。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can take a product photo you upload, first generate a premium product image, then turn it into a cinematic video advertisement.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you upload a product photo and say keywords like "product video ad" or "video ad maker".

say_en.text: Make a product video ad from this water bottle photo.
say_en.note: Claude will render the product image first, then generate the video.

say_en.text: Use this watch photo with flowers and morning light to create an ad video.
say_en.note: You can customize the scene description.
